research_name: GitHub open strategy repos (freqtrade-strategies, backtrader/vectorbt intraday examples, Jesse) with reproducible backtests
topic: transparent replicable intraday edges for cheap bot-allowed 5K/10K prop accounts (FundedNext Stellar Instant)
result_summary: Best-evidenced item is the Mroziewicz and Slepaczuk walk-forward study (arXiv 2602.10785, repo tmr-crypto/wf_optim_crypto): intraday, out-of-sample, 0.1% fee, reproducible R pipeline. It is Bitcoin (crypto, not futures), the EMA rule and slippage are not stated, and no numeric OOS metrics appear in the abstract. No open GitHub freqtrade, vectorbt, or Jesse repo with a futures intraday walk-forward and fully stated rules was found.
name: Mroziewicz and Slepaczuk EMA walk-forward double out-of-sample (BTC intraday) [uncertain]
author_year: Tomasz Mroziewicz, Robert Slepaczuk; 2026 (arXiv v1 11 Feb 2026)
instrument: Bitcoin primary (BTC); BNB and ETH used for cross-asset check. No Maven MT5 futures equivalent; crypto CFD mapping not verified. [uncertain]
timeframe: Intraday; six bar intervals 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60 minutes; OOS runs use 60 minutes per repo README
entry_rule: EMA-based signal. The crossover or signal logic is not stated in the abstract, arXiv page, or repo README. [uncertain]
holding_time: Not stated; position duration implied by the signal logic. [uncertain]
overnight_weekend: Not stated; crypto trades 24/7, so holding across weekends is implied. [uncertain]
signal_window_definition: Not applicable: crypto trades continuously; no session window, gap-return, or DST handling described.
sample_period: In-sample training 2018-01-01 to 2019-09-30 (filename); unseen OOS 2019-10-01 to 2021-09-20 (filename). Abstract says 19-month train and 21-month test, which conflicts with filename date spans of about 21 and 24 months. [uncertain]
out_of_sample: Yes. Two best-performing training parameter sets applied once to unseen period; window pairs 14-day train/10-day test and 7-day train/28-day test. Abstract: performance similar to Buy-and-Hold with lower drawdown and higher Information Ratio.
cost_assumption: 0.1% per transaction (called conservative in the abstract); break-even about 0.4% per transaction. Slippage not modelled or not stated.
reported_metrics: No numeric OOS return, Sharpe, or drawdown in abstract. Qualitative: training - all walk-forward window combinations beat Buy-and-Hold; testing - lower drawdown and higher Information Ratio than Buy-and-Hold; combined portfolio claims 50% drawdown reduction. Robust Sharpe Ratio used. Numbers sit in figures not extracted.
third_party_replication: None found. Companion analysis repo tmr-crypto/wf_optim_crypto_analysis exists but is by the same authors per the README link.
decay_status: Not assessed; OOS period 2019-2021 only, no post-2021 check.
regime_split: Train (2018-2019) and test (2019-2021) are time-separated but the split is not analysed by regime; test period includes the 2020-2021 crypto bull cycle. [uncertain]
data_source_requirement: Bitcoin intraday OHLCV 1-60 min (CSV packaged, 830 MB zip on Google Drive); data vendor and exchange not named. Maven MT5 BTC feed not verified. [uncertain]
min_lot_fit_5k10k: Not computable: no stop distance or position sizing published.
fn_rule_fit: Stellar Instant FN rules are not evaluated by the study. Crypto is not an FN instrument mapping that was verified. Holding and news rules not addressed. [uncertain]
bot_policy_compliance: Research code is R with DVC pipeline; not an EA. Automation feasibility on MT5 not verified. [uncertain]
event_overlap: Not addressed; crypto has no fixing, settlement, or macro-release windows in the study.
overlap_with_existing: Overlaps with BTC_21_23 module in concept (BTC intraday trend). Not tested against Donchian or Sweep.
rejected_catalog_hit: Not checked; run python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol EMA in the main session. [uncertain]
base_rate_check: Study compares to Buy-and-Hold, not to a random-entry baseline; no base-rate test given.
pitfall_risk: Parameter selection from many walk-forward combinations (81) with no multiple-testing correction; abstract's 19/21-month and filename date discrepancy; slippage omitted; crypto bull regime in test period; no statistical significance test.
